role_id.description: Stable identifier for the role or agent template (e.g. reviewer-security).

purpose.description: Why this role exists and what class of tasks it addresses.

expected_inputs.description: Artifacts, envelopes, or structured inputs the role requires before activation.

expected_outputs.description: Structured outputs or handoff fields the role must produce when used.

allowed_capabilities.description: Capability tokens (e.g. read_repo, call_mcp, network_egress) — policy layer will interpret.

activation_constraints.description: Human-readable constraints for when the role may be selected (machine policy comes in later tickets).

success_criteria.description: Observable conditions that indicate the role succeeded.

failure_conditions.description: Observable conditions that indicate the role failed or must not continue.
